title: Reading Drill — Planning a safer route from a nursery — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning a safer route from a nursery — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Brackenton, work on parents with prams sharing a narrow doorway with deliveries had already produced a small collection of caretaker logs. The nursery manager used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: obstructions at opening time.

**B** The group kept a separate delivery period for the new trial, which was planned to run for six weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that late food orders should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
